title: User story
description: An atomic, independently valuable slice with explicit acceptance criteria. 2-5 stories per epic.

type.description: story = user-visible value, chore = technical groundwork, spike = time-boxed experiment whose result is knowledge.

narrative.description: As a <role> I want <capability> so that <benefit>. Written in the project language.

effort.description: S = hours, M = one day, L = 2-3 days. Anything bigger should be split.

acceptance_criteria.description: Observable, checkable outcomes. Not implementation steps.

linked.description: Filled in as the story moves through plan -> implementation -> testing.
